_README: Alt text per photo, keyed by filename in photos/. Order on the page is the
filename order, so the numeric prefix is what you reorder with — the first
photo is the hero and the OpenGraph preview image.
Drop a new file into photos/ and the next build adds it here with
alt: null for you to fill in. Delete a file and remove its line.
Alt text is what a blind buyer and every search engine get instead of the
picture. Describe what is actually in frame, not the mood.
